title: Dual-channel fiber physical unclonable functions with persistent identity and reconfigurable credentials - analysis code
description: Analysis code accompanying the manuscript 'Dual-channel fiber physical unclonable functions with persistent identity and reconfigurable credentials': challenge generation, response preprocessing, zero-mean normalized cross-correlation and PUF-metric calculations, Fiber-ID identity features, statistical analysis, figure reproduction and enrollment-database disclosure attacks. Reproduces the principal analyses from the public dataset 10.5281/zenodo.22267156.
